cause: PendingDialog captures the page 2 gallery URL in its own ref. DetailPopup replaces it while the current URL is already a detail URL, so its separate gallery ref starts empty and the live-path guard correctly refuses to capture the detail URL. Closing the foreign history entry therefore falls back to the root prompt list.
feedExcluded: Every logged event has scrollY=0, pageMarker=2 and feedPages=[2]. The first incorrect replacement is issued by the DetailPopup exit-animation commit callback, not Feed page synchronization.
proposedFix: Let the persistent PopupHost own one stable gallery URL ref passed to both PendingDialog and DetailPopup. Retain live pathname capture guards. Add the held-lazy-script foreign-entry takeover regression on page 2; also preserve query/hash returns.
scope: Read-only diagnosis of existing artifact. Only temporary scripts/evidence were written. Await implementation and rebuilt-artifact verification.
